items.title_en: Frontier Airlines Attendant Made a Bad Baby Joke: Part Two
items.title_zh: 边疆航空乘务员开了一个坏婴儿玩笑：第二部分
items.summary_en: If you didn’t already read Frontier Airlines Attendant Made a Bad Baby Joke: Part One , use the link to check it out. Because this is part two. And allegedly this was all before the attendant demanded the mother take the baby into the bathroom until he stopped crying. “She was guilting this mom over her crying baby,” Nicole states, “apparently with @Frontier Airlines you need to pay an extra fee for respect,” she added in the caption.
items.summary_zh: 如果您还没有阅读边疆航空乘务员开了一个坏婴儿笑话：第一部分，请使用链接查看。因为这是第二部分。据称，这一切都是在服务员要求母亲将婴儿带进浴室直到他停止哭泣之前发生的。 “她因为孩子哭闹而对这位妈妈感到内疚，”妮可说，“显然，在@Frontier Airlines，你需要支付额外的费用来获得尊重，”她在标题中补充道。
